As pointed out above, the proper method of dealing with this issue is within the jurisdiction of DOT's Federal Highway Administration. We note that that agency published a notice of rulemaking to consider the question of safety regulations within expanded commercial zones, 41 Fed. Reg. 8175 (1976). Consequently, we feel that the safety issue shall be adequately resolved by that agency's proposed action.
FINDINGS 
We find that Part 1000 of Chapter X of Title 49 of the Code of Federal Regulations should be amended as set forth in the attached notice; that such rules are reasonable and necessary to effectuate the public interest and to promote the goals of the National Transportation Policy; that such rules are consistent with the relevant sections of the Interstate Commerce Act; and that the rules adopted herein shall become effective 90 days from the date of publication of the attached notice in the Federal Register.
